CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, JUNE 27, 2025 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments. Written Zoom comments will be read or summarized,
  then printed and made part of the public record for the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, and
Mayor Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  PRESENTATION

 PRESENTATION OF  PROCLAMATION  FOR  JULY  AS  PARKS  AND
 RECREATION MONTH

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  CONSIDERATION OF SEWER SERVICE CHARGE RATES FOR FISCAL
  YEARS 2026 TO 2030: CONSIDER STAFF PRESENTATION, WRITTEN
  OBJECTIONS FROM PROPERTY OWNERS, AND RESPONSES FROM
  STAFF; HOLD PUBLIC HEARING ON SEWER SERVICE CHARGES FOR

AGENDA – JUNE 27, 2025  PAGE 2 of 4
   FISCAL YEARS 2026 TO 2030, CONSIDER PROTESTS, AND ADOPT
  RESOLUTION NO. R-25-21 ESTABLISHING SEWER SERVICE CHARGES
  WITH ANNUAL UPDATES THROUGH JULY 1, 2029; CONSIDER
  ADOPTING ORDINANCE NO. O-25-1420, AMENDING THE SAN MARINO
  CITY CODE TO ADD SECTION 16.06.03 (SEWER SERVICE CHARGES)
  TO SAN MARINO CITY CODE CHAPTER XVI, ARTICLE 6; AND
  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-25-20 AUTHORIZING THE
  COLLECTION OF SEWER SERVICE CHARGES ON THE LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY PROPERTY TAX ROLL FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council:

  Hold Public Hearing and consider public testimony regarding sewer service charges
  for Fiscal Years 2025-26 to 2029-30; and placing sewer service charges on the
  County tax rolls for Fiscal Year 2025-26;

  Consider timely written objections and written responses for sewer service charges
  for fiscal years 2025-26 to 2029-30 and move forward with the public hearing;

  Consider timely written protests, and if no majority protest is received, adopt
  Resolution No. R-25-21 Establishing Sewer Service Charges with Annual Updates
  through July 1, 2029;

  Consider approving the first reading of Ordinance O-25-1420, amending the San
  Marino City Code to Add Section 16.06.03 (Sewer Service Charges to San Marino City
  Code Chapter XVI Article 6); and

  Approve Resolution No. R-25-20 Authorizing the Collection of Sewer Service Charges
  on the Los Angeles County Property Tax Roll for Fiscal Year 2025-2026.

  If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Resolution R-25-21 Establishing Sewer Service Charges with Annual
  Updates through July 1, 2029; waive full reading and introduce by title only
  Ordinance O-25-1420, amending the San Marino City Code to Add Section 16.06.03
  (Sewer Service Charges to San Marino City Code Chapter XVI Article 6); and adopt
  Resolution R-25-20 Authorizing the Collection of Sewer Service Charges on the Los
  Angeles County Property Tax Roll for Fiscal Year 2025-26.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  APPROVAL TO PROCURE AND INSTALL PHASE TWO OF THE LACY
  PARK PLAYGROUND REPLACEMENT PROJECT FROM PACIFIC PLAY
  SYSTEMS, INC.

  The staff report for this item is forthcoming.

 3.  APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 4 WITH ECONOMICS, INC. FOR SOLID

AGENDA – JUNE 27, 2025  PAGE 3 of 4
   WASTE CONSULTING SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $99,304 AND
  APPROVAL OF A FY 24-25 BUDGET AMENDMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $111,550

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 4
  to the agreement with Economics, Inc. for solid waste consulting services, increasing
  the contract amount by $99,304, and approve a budget amendment to the FY 2024-
  25 budget appropriating $111,550 into Account #101-40-4104-0000. If the Council
  concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Amendment No. 4 to the agreement with Economics, Inc. for
  solid waste consulting services increasing the contract amount by $99,304, authorize
  the City Manager to execute the Amendment on behalf of the City, and approve a
  budget amendment to the FY 24-25 budget appropriating $111,550 into Account
  #101-40-4104-0000.”

 4.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF MAY 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of May
  2025.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
